title: Relief on Storage Billed at a Specialised Daily Rate (Repair Estimates & Appointments)
content:
**Relief schedule.** A Repair Estimates & Appointments storage statement billed at a specialised daily rate earns a fixed relief. The statement's average billed-day value is the storage statement charge divided by its billed days, counted from its first to its last billed day both included.

- An average billed-day value of at least **1.5** times the estimate type's daily storage rate earns **40.00 USD**.
- One of at least **1.2** times but under **1.5** times that rate earns **20.00 USD**.
- A lower average earns none.

That relief is added to the goodwill figure.

**Thresholds in figures**

| Estimate type (daily storage rate) | 1.5 times the rate | 1.2 times the rate |
|---|---|---|
| Blueprint Teardown Estimate (55.00 USD) | 82.50 USD | 66.00 USD |
| Structural Blueprint Estimate (65.00 USD) | 97.50 USD | 78.00 USD |

**Worked figures** (hypothetical statements on a Blueprint Teardown Estimate)

1. 850.00 USD for 10 billed days: average 85.00 USD, at least 82.50 USD — relief 40.00 USD.
2. 700.00 USD for 10 billed days: average 70.00 USD, at least 66.00 USD but under 82.50 USD — relief 20.00 USD.
3. 550.00 USD for 10 billed days: average 55.00 USD, under 66.00 USD — no relief.
4. 825.00 USD for 10 billed days: average exactly 82.50 USD — relief 40.00 USD.
